payload.description_html:
• Scale diagram of the large adult specimens of Edmontosaurus regalis (MOR 003) and Edmontosaurus annectens (USNM 12711), compared in size with a human. Each grid section represents 1 square meter.
  • Adapted from illustrations by Nobu Tamura and Matt Martyniuk.
  • Length based on estimates found in:
Lull, Richard Swann; and Wright, Nelda E. (1942). Hadrosaurian Dinosaurs of North America. Geological Society of America Special Paper 40. Geological Society of America. p. 225.
